description.content: Retrieves the customer profile of a MTN customer. The customer profile includes 4 main objects: Location (Country and Operator), Billing Plan and related details, Subscriptions for VAS and Digital Services, Loans details, and Transactions Summaries

query.description: the set of data to be retrieved. There are 2 options - `basic` will retrieve only the structure of the customer profile including the links to each resource, will `full` will retrieve all the data for each resource, which will be en expensive call. If not specified, the default will be `basic`
The language in which the response is required

variable.description: (Required) ID of the customer. It could be MSISDN, email address, or any other customer identifier. if id is msisdn, format must be E.123

header.description: Encrypted ECW credentials

response.name: Customer Profile object. For a successful request, it will contain all the customers details. If the customer does not have any requested data, then it will be null. E.g. if the customer does not any location set, then Country and Operator will be null.
